answer: Sybil resistance is escrowed per seat, not per identity. A joining agent locks an entry deposit plus a per-seat stake, and the ledger charges each seat rent every epoch. Ten thousand puppets need ten thousand funded stakes burning rent at once; one deposit cannot cover many aliases, and a dying swarm leaves a public plume of drained stake. Seats must also keep a quartz-hard proof-of-work sample fresh, so idle aliases decay and are slashed before payout. Farming stays possible, but carry turns negative: a marginal Sybil operator tunnels capital into the karst while honest seats keep earning.
